title: Sell Mineral Rights in Dushore, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Dushore, PA | Sullivan County
metaDescription: Dushore anchors sparsely populated Sullivan County, dry-gas Marcellus core territory. We buy PA mineral and royalty interests directly, cash offer, no broker.
heroLead: Dushore is the seat of Sullivan County, one of the least populated counties in Pennsylvania and, somewhat surprisingly to outsiders, one of the more consistently productive dry-gas corners of the entire Marcellus play.
intro: Sullivan County doesn't have many people, but it has a lot of contiguous, undeveloped timber and farmland, which turned out to be exactly what large-scale Marcellus dry-gas operators wanted when leasing ramped up in the northeast part of the state. Families around Dushore who've held land for generations sometimes found themselves holding some of the more valuable mineral acreage in the entire region, without ever setting out to be in the gas business.
We buy Dushore-area mineral and royalty interests directly, and because this is genuinely productive dry-gas ground, we look closely at nearby well performance before making an offer.

sections.heading: Sparse Population, Dense Gas Production
paragraphs: Sullivan County's low population has meant land here has stayed in large, contiguous tracts far more than in more developed parts of the state, and that made it attractive to operators like Anadarko, historically, and others assembling large dry-gas units. Dushore-area acreage sits within a footprint that's produced some of the strongest well results anywhere in the northeastern Pennsylvania play.
Because this is dry gas, value here tracks more directly with benchmark natural gas prices than the liquids-heavy wet-gas plays of southwestern Pennsylvania.

sections.heading: Large Family Tracts and Fair Division Among Heirs
paragraphs: A lot of Dushore-area mineral ownership traces back to large original family farms and timber tracts that have since been divided among children and grandchildren. If your family's land was part of one of these larger holdings, your current interest might represent a meaningful share of a genuinely productive unit, even if the acreage itself feels modest to you personally.
We evaluate fractional interests like this regularly and can make an offer on your specific share, regardless of how the rest of the family has divided theirs.

sections.heading: The Courthouse in a Small County Seat
paragraphs: Dushore's small size means the Sullivan County Recorder of Deeds office is a genuinely local institution, and title records here, while sometimes old, tend to be well known to the people who work there. We do our own research through those records rather than asking you to make the trip yourself.

faqs.question: Is Sullivan County actually a productive part of the Marcellus play, despite being so rural?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its large, contiguous undeveloped tracts made it attractive to dry-gas operators, and it's produced some of the stronger well results in the northeastern Pennsylvania play.

faqs.question: My family's Dushore-area land was divided among several heirs. Can you buy just my share?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly evaluate and buy individual fractional interests without requiring the rest of the family to sell theirs.

faqs.question: How is dry gas different from what southwestern PA counties produce?
faqs.answer: Dry gas is almost entirely methane and is priced against benchmark natural gas, tracking more directly with broader gas market prices than the liquids-heavy wet-gas plays.
